==Usage instructions==

Add <nowiki>{{Spoiler page|work}}</nowiki> to an article page where the entire page consists of spoilers from ''work''.

==Examples==

 <nowiki>{{Spoiler page}}</nowiki>

{{Spoiler page}}

 <nowiki>{{Spoiler page|''{{Wlink|lotr|The Lord of the Rings}}''}}</nowiki>

{{Spoiler page|''{{Wlink|lotr|The Lord of the Rings}}''}}
